master: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished game screenshot P03 for Wax Pop / 왁스팝, portrait 9:16 image, high quality commercial casual mobile puzzle. No phone frame. Cream white background with very subtle mint haze, soft rounded cream tray, exactly 7 columns and 8 rows of round soft wax balls. Four pastel colours mint, peach, lavender, pale cream yellow, clear distinct tiny surface marks: mint small leaf, peach tiny dash, purple 3 dots, yellow small ring. Each ball has THIN cloudy matte wax coating and slightly translucent jelly core, gentle irregular rounded silhouette, broad soft upper-left light, minimal highlights, small soft contact shadow. Absolutely NOT hard glass marbles, no sharp specular rim, no neon, no metallic, no jewels, no brand characters. Make balls occupy most of screen, clear gaps. Top UI neat rounded panels in dark plum: exact Korean text '단계 4', '목표' with mint ball icon and '18', remaining-moves peach circle '20', pause icon. Bottom short caption '같은 색을 3개 이상 이어요'. Large simple pill buttons. Leave sufficient portrait safe area. Minimal decorative clutter. This is the visual master for 15 coherent screens. Material evidence to translate: squished soft ball bulges around thumb; wax forms irregular shallow flakes, gelatin core is more transparent than cloudy shell; clear slime has tiny sparse bubbles; butter slime has broad folded planes. Do not copy any researched product logo or character. Deliver only the single screenshot.
